policy_delivery_guarantee: Exact canonical policy bytes are embedded or loaded by a vendor-documented native mechanism; model behavior is not guaranteed.

cursor.important_limit: selection uses alwaysApply, description, and globs

codex.strategy: full exact bodies embedded in AGENTS.md
codex.important_limit: default project instruction limit is 32 KiB; project trust and 262144-byte setting are required

claude.important_limit: instructions are context, not enforced configuration

copilot.strategy: one global instruction file per exact policy body
copilot.important_limit: support and combination behavior vary by Copilot surface and IDE

gemini.important_limit: hierarchical context can add more-specific instructions

hermes.strategy: full exact bodies embedded in highest-priority project context file
hermes.important_limit: context_file_max_chars or dynamic model limit must accommodate the full file without truncation

opencode.important_limit: other local and global instructions are combined and require conflict review

zed.important_limit: nested and user rules can add guidance; verify in Agent Panel

warp.important_limit: WARP.md takes precedence when both names exist in one directory
